articles.title: Israel’s largest crypto broker Bits of Gold hit by data breach affecting 200,000 customers
articles.snippet: Funds and digital assets were not touched, but names, bank account details, and national ID numbers may have been exposed in what the company says was a wider global attack.

articles.title: September Fed interest-rate increase is 'very unlikely,' Goldman Sachs says
articles.snippet: Soft economic data has Goldman Sachs doubting a September rate increase, offering good news for bitcoin bulls.

articles.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
articles.snippet: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

articles.title: Israel’s largest bank taps Galaxy to offer Bitcoin, Ether, Solana trading
articles.snippet: Bank Leumi customers will be able to buy, hold and sell three major cryptocurrencies directly through the bank’s investment app beginning in early 2027.
